page.layout: One column of running text, with a title block in italic lines and a centred heading. Running head centred at top, page number at top right. Catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: num Ecclesiae Maronitarum, quae le-guntur Syriace in eorum Ecclesiis, & conversae habentur in Linguam Ara-bicam; modus administrandi Sacramenti Poenitentiae apud eosdem Ma-ronitas; figura Ecclesiae Maronita-rum.
main_text.head: Capita Epitomes Constitutionum Ecclesiae Maronitarum ad clarissimum, doctissimum & charissimum virum Johannem Morinum, Congreg. orat. Jesu Christi Presbyterum.
main_text.p: HIc liber legitur Syriace in Ecclesiis Maronitarum, cujus hic habemus Arabicam versionem Davidis Archiepiscopi factam æra Alexandri 1370, scilicet Domini 1059. rogantibus Abbate Josepho & Monachis.
main_text.head: Cap. 1. De Ecclesia & iis, quae ad eam attinent, & continent 7 Sectiones.
Sectio Prima.
Sectio 2. In quibus impendendae sunt facultates legatae Ecclesiae.
Sectio 3. De Decimis.
Sectio 4. De Procuratore Ecclesiae.

page.notes: The catchword at lower right is partly obscured; read as "Sec" with doubt. Dates "1370" and "1059" are printed with old-style figures and read with confidence, though the "1059" is slightly blurred. Scan has spots and show-through, which were left out.
